title: Take the Aurora Winter Train across Alaska
description: Board in Anchorage and let the landscape change at rail speed: towns give way to snowy backcountry, river valleys, and long views toward Denali when the sky clears. The train follows a route through Talkeetna and the roadless Hurricane area before reaching Fairbanks. Large windows, warm seats, and a dining car make the long ride a pleasure rather than a transfer.
teaser: Spend a winter day crossing Alaska by rail.
whyItMightDelightYou: There is no need to chase the view. The scenery comes to your window, slowly enough to notice a moose or a distant peak.
goodToKnow: The Aurora Winter Train runs on selected winter days. Choose a comfortable seat, then settle in for the scenery.
